page: OVHcloud b2-60 is a general-purpose server instance built on the KVM hypervisor and powered by an x86_64 Intel Haswell processor. The configuration features 16 dedicated physical cores with a single thread per core, running at a base clock speed of 2.0 GHz. It includes 60.0 GB of system memory, providing 3.75 GB per core, alongside a bundled 400 GB local SSD and a baseline network bandwidth of 1 Gbps. The processor architecture supports AVX, AES, BMI2, and FMA instructions, but lacks AVX-512 capabilities.

Benchmark data indicates average multi-core performance, with a Geekbench multi-core score of 9327.0 and a Passmark CPU score of 18774.29. However, single-core performance is relatively weak, as shown by a stress-ng single-core score of 1067.12 and a bzip3 single-threaded decompression rate of 8.52 GB/sec. Memory read bandwidth is average, reaching 45.81 GB/sec for large blocks, but large block write bandwidth is weak at 20.8 GB/sec.

With dedicated CPU allocation and balanced memory density, this instance offers stable resource availability for multi-threaded workloads. It is suitable for static web serving, software compilation, and database operations, supported by a Passmark database score of 9580.52 and Redis SET performance of 19.76 million operations per second. However, it is less suited for single-threaded tasks or intensive large-model LLM inference, where text generation speeds for medium 7B models drop to 8.07 tokens per second.
